final: WITH order_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) as overall_avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(os.avg_rebtotal) as mean_rebtotal, AVG(os.avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_net_fee_rate, AVG(os.avg_net_fee_rate - ov.overall_avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_excess FROM order_stats os, overall_avg ov WHERE os.avg_net_fee_rate > ov.overall_avg_net_fee_rate
